wikt:lang:nds.rationale: Wiktionary nds is the broader Low German umbrella; the local Glottolog Low German family is a useful catalog context. This does not establish exact historical extension. nds-de and nds-nl are regular codes in this Wiktionary snapshot, not etymology-only codes.
wikt:lang:nds.purpose: catalog lookup; no chronology or sample identity transfer

wikt:lang:ang.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) reviewing Astra's source check, dating period pilot 2026-10-03
wikt:lang:ang.purpose: dating: whether a period a source states for the target applies to the whole Wiktionary code (including etymology-only varieties filed under it); no chronology transfer
wikt:lang:ang.rationale: ISO 639-3 registers the same code and stage name; Wiktionary uses the ISO code. Anglian, Mercian and Northumbrian, filed under ang, are Old English dialects.

wikt:lang:ang.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) reviewing Astra's source check, dating period pilot 2026-10-03
wikt:lang:ang.purpose: dating: whether a period a source states for the target applies to the whole Wiktionary code (including etymology-only varieties filed under it); no chronology transfer
wikt:lang:ang.rationale: Glottolog Old English (ca. 450-1100), ISO ang; same stage and dialect scope as Wiktionary ang.

wikt:lang:enm.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) reviewing Astra's source check, dating period pilot 2026-10-03
wikt:lang:enm.purpose: dating: whether a period a source states for the target applies to the whole Wiktionary code (including etymology-only varieties filed under it); no chronology transfer
wikt:lang:enm.rationale: ISO 639-3 registers the same code and stage name; Wiktionary uses the ISO code. Wiktionary files Early Scots under enm, classing it as Middle English; ISO's 1100-1500 covers it.

wikt:lang:enm.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) reviewing Astra's source check, dating period pilot 2026-10-03
wikt:lang:enm.purpose: dating: whether a period a source states for the target applies to the whole Wiktionary code (including etymology-only varieties filed under it); no chronology transfer
wikt:lang:enm.rationale: Glottolog Middle English, ISO enm; same scope as Wiktionary enm including Early Scots, as for the ISO decision.

wikt:lang:gmh.rationale: ISO 639-3 registers the same code and stage name; Wiktionary uses the ISO code. No etymology-only varieties are filed under gmh.

wikt:lang:gmh.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) reviewing Astra's source check, dating period pilot 2026-10-03
wikt:lang:gmh.purpose: dating: whether a period a source states for the target applies to the whole Wiktionary code (including etymology-only varieties filed under it); no chronology transfer
wikt:lang:gmh.rationale: Glottolog Middle High German, ISO gmh; same scope.

wikt:lang:goh.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) reviewing Astra's source check, dating period pilot 2026-10-03
wikt:lang:goh.purpose: dating: whether a period a source states for the target applies to the whole Wiktionary code (including etymology-only varieties filed under it); no chronology transfer
wikt:lang:goh.rationale: Wiktionary files Lombardic under goh; ISO registers Langobardic separately (lng), so ISO goh is narrower.

wikt:lang:goh.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) reviewing Astra's source check, dating period pilot 2026-10-03
wikt:lang:goh.purpose: dating: whether a period a source states for the target applies to the whole Wiktionary code (including etymology-only varieties filed under it); no chronology transfer
wikt:lang:goh.rationale: Glottolog Old High German excludes Lombardic, which Wiktionary files under goh.

wikt:lang:sga.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) reviewing Astra's source check, dating period pilot 2026-10-03
wikt:lang:sga.purpose: dating: whether a period a source states for the target applies to the whole Wiktionary code (including etymology-only varieties filed under it); no chronology transfer
wikt:lang:sga.rationale: ISO 639-3 registers the same code and stage name; Wiktionary uses the ISO code. Old Irish (to 900).

wikt:lang:sga.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) reviewing Astra's source check, dating period pilot 2026-10-03
wikt:lang:sga.purpose: dating: whether a period a source states for the target applies to the whole Wiktionary code (including etymology-only varieties filed under it); no chronology transfer
wikt:lang:sga.rationale: Glottolog oldi1245 is Early Irish, an umbrella including Primitive and Middle Irish; Wiktionary sga is Old Irish only.

wikt:lang:grc.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) reviewing Astra's source check, dating period pilot 2026-10-03
wikt:lang:grc.purpose: dating: whether a period a source states for the target applies to the whole Wiktionary code (including etymology-only varieties filed under it); no chronology transfer
wikt:lang:grc.rationale: ISO 639-3 registers the same code and stage name; Wiktionary uses the ISO code. ISO Ancient Greek runs to 1453, matching Wiktionary's grc, which files Koine and Byzantine Greek under it.

wikt:lang:grc.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) reviewing Astra's source check, dating period pilot 2026-10-03
wikt:lang:grc.purpose: dating: whether a period a source states for the target applies to the whole Wiktionary code (including etymology-only varieties filed under it); no chronology transfer
wikt:lang:grc.rationale: Glottolog anci1242 is Ionic-Attic Ancient Greek; Wiktionary grc also covers other dialects, Koine and Byzantine Greek.

wikt:lang:got.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) reviewing Astra's source check, dating period pilot 2026-10-03

wikt:lang:got.rationale: Glottolog Gothic, ISO got; same language, no varieties filed under got.

wikt:lang:akk.purpose: dating: whether a period a source states for the target applies to the whole Wiktionary code (including etymology-only varieties filed under it); no chronology transfer

wikt:lang:hit.purpose: dating: whether a period a source states for the target applies to the whole Wiktionary code (including etymology-only varieties filed under it); no chronology transfer

wikt:lang:och.rationale: Glottolog Old Chinese, ISO och; Wiktionary files Early and Late Old Chinese under och.

wikt:lang:ltc.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) reviewing Astra's source check, dating period pilot 2026-10-03
wikt:lang:ltc.purpose: dating: whether a period a source states for the target applies to the whole Wiktionary code (including etymology-only varieties filed under it); no chronology transfer
wikt:lang:ltc.rationale: Glottolog midd1344 is Middle Chinese as a whole stage; Wiktionary ltc is Middle Chinese with Early and Late Middle Chinese filed under it.

wikt:lang:ltc.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) reviewing Astra's source check, dating period pilot 2026-10-03
wikt:lang:ltc.purpose: dating: whether a period a source states for the target applies to the whole Wiktionary code (including etymology-only varieties filed under it); no chronology transfer
wikt:lang:ltc.rationale: ISO's reference name for ltc is Late Middle Chinese; Wiktionary uses the code for Middle Chinese as a whole.

wikt:lang:ojp.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) reviewing Astra's source check, dating period pilot 2026-10-03
wikt:lang:ojp.purpose: dating: whether a period a source states for the target applies to the whole Wiktionary code (including etymology-only varieties filed under it); no chronology transfer
wikt:lang:ojp.rationale: Wiktionary files Middle Japanese (Early and Late) under ojp; Glottolog oldj1239 is Old Japanese only.

wikt:lang:la.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) reviewing Astra's scope check, 2026-10-03
wikt:lang:la.rationale: Wiktionary files Old Latin (itc-ola) under la; Glottolog classifies Old Latin (oldl1238) as a separate language beside Latin (lati1261), whose children are Late, Medieval and Vulgar Latin.
